structure.unit: Enforcement, Collection, Refunds, Remedies and Review of Local Taxes
Correction of Assessments, Remedies and Refunds

law.catch_line: Section 58.1-3984 not applicable to applications for correction of assessments for local improvements
law.text: Section 58.1-3984 shall not apply to applications for correction of assessments for local improvements provided for in Article 2 (§ 15.2-2404 et seq.) of Chapter 24 of Title 15.2 of this Code or the charter of any city or town.
